title: Audit gap detected
description: A gap was detected in a source's sequence of events during ingestion (AUD-02).

source.description: The event source whose sequence had a gap.

expected_seq.description: The sequence number expected next from this source.

gap_size.description: Number of missing sequence positions (received_seq - expected_seq).

instance_id.description: The module instance that published the batch, if known.
